text: Treat exact words like toy blocks: match them only when the source says the block’s shape matters; otherwise match the behavior built from them.
rationale: This separates contract-critical wording and model strings from brittle descriptive assertions without waiving substantive checks.

text: Require each bespoke helper to declare the uncovered behavior and expected counterexample it targets.
rationale: Separates guidance gaps from execution errors and exposes unchanged-surface tests.

text: When a checker fails, make it point to the first broken arrow—source, behavior, or report—instead of launching a new checker.
rationale: The next action becomes evidence-led repair, not an arbitrary retry or duplicate script.
